scores.evidence: There are four can-do objectives with matching Bloom verbs, and each has 2 or more graded items: o1 q1/q5, o2 q2/q6, o3 q3/q7, o4 q4/q8/q10/q9. Two verbs are only weakly observed. o1's 「依頼文に書き換え」 is tested only by picking a pre-written request (q1 d, q5 a). Of the o4 items, only q10 gives the learner a plan to review; q4 and q8 ask about plans in general.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「グラフや分類が並んだ画面がすぐにできました。でも、ほしかったのは「月の途中で食費の使いすぎに気づける」ことでした。」) with no trivia. hook-predict q0 is ungraded, gives feedback on every option and leads into 2-1/2-2.

The prerequisites list ch0 and ch1. s1-b1 recalls ch0 (「人間の仕事は「ビジョンを示すこと」…」) and ex-data recalls the ch1 database. Each segment defines its new terms in a definitions block before using them (壁打ち, 目的・機能, MVP・MoSCoW, 1枚企画書/PRD), and the definitions match the glossary.

Lint is clean, each segment has at most 2 new terms, and estMinutes is 18. Section 2-3 is still the heaviest screen: s3-b1, s3-defs, a 6-step example, the s2-b4 diagram, the s2-b3 prompt whose expect restates every step's output, and s3-check. It also introduces 画面の流れ and 扱うデータ only inside the steps.

s3-steps is a 6-step worked example with subgoal titles, and most steps give a reason (「目的の1文は、あとの手順の物差しになります」, 「決めないと、AIが推測で項目を選びます」). ex-review gives no reason. No faded example follows, and independent practice now lives in the separate vibe-ch2-practice draft.

Every content section ends with an inline check set in a new context (散歩 q1, 送迎当番 q2, 読書記録 q3, empty Won't q4), and every option has feedback. q2 a (「保護者が、当番表をアプリでいつでも見られる」) makes the learner analyze rather than match words. The one weak item is q8: its key d repeats o4's wording 「目的から「やらないこと」まで」.

All four misconceptions in the brief are corrected in the body (s1-b5, s2-b1, s5-b1, s3-b1) and in feedback of at most 2 sentences (q4 a, q5 d, q8 a/c, q7 c, q10 b/c, q9 c/d). Two weak spots remain. q6 b (「カレンダーなら、すぐAIに作ってもらおうか？」) is a strawman, not a question meant to draw out a goal. In the body, s3-b1 corrects 「最初から完璧に」 without a reason; only q8 c's feedback gives one.

s2-b4 is a 3-node process diagram. Its labels match the text (今月の残り画面, 支出の入力画面), its caption states the takeaway (「Mustだけなら、最初の版の画面は2つで足りる」), and it has alt and a description in jp and en. The two tables are comparisons, and there are no images.

The practice section moved to drafts/vibe-ch2-practice.lesson.json. In this lesson the learner can still try two prompts that state the expected result: s1-b4, whose expect says the AI asks one question at a time, and s2-b3, whose expect is a full model plan. There is no checklist or hint ladder here, and no line invites the learner to run s1-b4 now.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next adds a reflection question (「Won'tに入れる機能は何でしょう？理由も1つ考えてみましょう。」) and a next step (the practice lesson, then ch4), and the section also has 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

I re-fetched cc-best-practices and confirmed the cited quotes: 「頭の中までは読めません」, 「違う問題を解く」, interview-first, and 'state what is out of scope' (q4). The MVP and MoSCoW definitions match Ries and the ABC. Two uncited simplifications remain. s5-b3 says 「最初の版はMustで作り」, but the ABC timebox can also deliver Shoulds and Coulds. q9 b's key also changes 「画面の流れ」, although the scenario changes only what a screen shows.

The text uses です・ます throughout, is warm (「最初から完璧でなくてかまいません」) and has no banned phrases. 通知, 目的 and 機能 are used consistently. A few spots are hard to parse: in s5-b3 「果たせないものだけをMustにします」 the subject is unclear, and q4's attribution 「AIツールの開発元のガイドも」 is vague.

Every learner-facing string has jp and en, including the mermaid labels, alt, description and per-locale prompt vars. The EN reads naturally ("With only the Musts, the first version needs just two screens"), there are no links, and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: q9 (check-quiz): the scenario changes what the 今月の残り画面 shows, not the order of screens. Reword option b to 「先に企画書のMustと画面の中身を直し、次の版を頼む」 (EN "Update the plan's Musts and what the screen shows first…") so the key does not teach that 画面の流れ must change.

s5-b3: present 「最初の版はMustで作り」 as this lesson's MVP choice (e.g. 「このレッスンでは、最初の版をMustだけで作ります」), because the ABC MoSCoW timebox can also include Shoulds and Coulds. Also make the subject explicit: 「なくても目的を果たせないものだけをMustにします」.

q6 b (check-quiz): replace the strawman with a real belief, e.g. a closed question that assumes the goal: 「カレンダーがあれば、予定を忘れなくなるよね？」, with feedback that a leading question puts your guess in place of the friend's goal.
q8 (check-quiz): the key d repeats the o4 objective's wording. Consider giving a short flawed plan in the prompt, as q10 does, so o4's 「読み返し、直すところ…を判断」 is actually exercised.

s1-b4: add one line before or after the prompt inviting the learner to try it now with their own idea and to check the result against expect. The brief budgets about 3 minutes for this, and the lesson otherwise has no hands-on moment with a success check.
ex-review (s3-steps): add the reason, e.g. 「AIのまとめは推測が混ざるので、意図と違うところを自分で見つけて直します。」
s2-b3.expect restates every step's output. Trimming it to what the steps did not show (使う人, やらないこと) would lighten section 2-3.

Owner (course.json): list vibe-ch2-practice in module m2 after vibe-ch2 and change vibe-ch2's estMinutes from 30 to 18. Until then summary-next names a lesson the course outline does not show, and this lesson has no hint-laddered practice.
summary: Biggest strength: the lesson is tightly aligned and active, with a 3-sentence hook and an ungraded predict, one idea per segment, and an inline check after every segment. Every quiz is set in a new context, wrong options carry real beliefs, and feedback is short. Most important fix: tighten the remaining weak items. q9 b's 「画面の流れ」, the vague s5-b3 Must rule, the strawman q6 b and the generic q8 make the o3/o4 judgments less precise than the objectives promise. Practice still depends on the owner listing vibe-ch2-practice in course.json.
